document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
While exploring a prehistoric glade, you chance upon a stand 
of plants of the very species recently described in detail by your 
Miskatonic colleague, the paleobotanist Ivan Kurtov. The species 
was thought extinct before the Pleistocene glaciations. Yet, here 
it is, all around you, still flourishing. You can easily take leaves, 
roots, cuttings, and seeds to convince Miskatonic’s geology and 
botany departments to sponsor a major expedition.

Excited, you pack the specimens and lead your companions 
without mishap back to the outer valley of the North Hanninah.
Record the keyword BACKWATER. Go to 217.
